name: Contraption Save Load
description: A build you can hand to someone else. A contraption serialises to parts, joints and their tuning — never to simulation state, because a save that captured mid-flight velocities would restore a machine already falling over. Versioning is the real problem: a build shared today must still load after a joint kind gains an input, so the format carries a version and unknown fields are preserved rather than dropped, which is what lets an old client round-trip a newer build without silently destroying it. Loading is validated before it is applied, so a corrupt share is refused whole rather than leaving half a machine in the scene.

inputs.name: formatVersion
inputs.description: Schema version written into every save.

inputs.name: preserveUnknownFields
inputs.description: Whether fields this client does not understand survive a round-trip. The only thing that makes sharing across versions safe.

inputs.name: validateBeforeApply
inputs.description: Whether a load is checked whole before anything is spawned, so a corrupt share leaves no half-machine behind.

inputs.name: maxParts
inputs.description: Parts a single contraption may contain.

outputs.name: lastLoadResult
outputs.description: Outcome of the most recent load, including refusals.

outputs.name: partCount
outputs.description: Parts in the contraption currently in the scene.
